verdict.rationale: Brex markets multiple AI-generated insight features (AI-powered expense assistant, automated invoice entry/GL coding, 'AI-powered financial operations') per brex-docs-7/9/16, suggesting the product does surface AI-driven suggestions from user data. However, hands-on community evidence from Brex's own public demo of this expense-assistant capability found it produced an outright incorrect answer (misidentifying the most recent receipt date) and relied on a non-deterministic LLM in a financial context, raising real doubts about reliability of these insights (brex-comm-1, brex-comm-2, brex-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent verification of accuracy in production, transparency on model/methodology, and resolution of the documented output error.
